summary: Spot-the-Difference photoreal PNG asset rollout verified end-to-end across all 8 themes. Created /app/backend/tests/test_spot_assets.py (27 new tests) and re-ran existing test_spot_library.py (16 tests). All 43 tests PASS. Backend correctly injects `asset_url` (e.g. `/api/static/spot_objects//.png`) on scene_a + scene_b elements for cafes→coffee, australian_gardens→garden, wildlife, kitchens, country_towns, classic_cars, parks_trails, beaches→beach. swap_emoji diffs (e.g. parrot→🦩 flamingo on wildlife; crab→🦞 lobster on beach) correctly populate `asset_url` on the swap target in scene_b. emoji is preserved as fallback. All 8 canonical PNG files return 200 with valid PNG magic bytes. All 12 library puzzles (p001–p012) resolve with themed asset URLs. Frontend smoke (mobile viewport 390x844 as `frankie` flow): /games/spot grid renders 12 photo thumbnails (13 elements); /games/spot/play?lib=p003 renders 31 elements with 16 captured /api/static/spot_objects/beach/*.png requests, all 200 OK — palm trees, umbrella, seagulls, kite, wave, sailboat, starfish, crab, fish, ice cream, shells, ball all visible as photoreal PNGs (not emoji). No deprecated Expo packages introduced. No SafeAreaView issues observed.
critical_code_review_comments: spot_difference.py: _attach_asset_urls() does a filesystem stat (base_dir / slug.png).exists() on every element of every puzzle request. For high-traffic this could be cached (e.g. lru_cache on (folder, slug)), but acceptable for current scale.
Backend logs show WatchFiles repeatedly reloading on spot_difference.py edits — confirms server-reload triggered cleanly during rollout.

success_rate.frontend: 100% smoke pass — PNG image rendering confirmed, all PNG requests 200 OK

seed_data_creation: None. Used existing demo users (frankie/maggie) and existing 12 library puzzles + 136 asset PNGs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Asset rollout is healthy. New regression test file /app/backend/tests/test_spot_assets.py covers per-theme asset_url injection (scene_a + scene_b), swap_emoji target asset_url resolution (parrot→flamingo wildlife, crab→lobster beach), static PNG file serving with magic-byte validation, and library-wide asset_url coverage on all 12 launch puzzles. Use it as the regression gate for future changes to spot_difference.py THEME_ASSETS/ELEMENT_ASSETS/SWAP_ASSETS tables or the PNG directories under /app/backend/static/spot_objects/.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no defects found. All 8 themes correctly serve photoreal PNGs; emoji fallback intact for unmapped elements; frontend correctly switches between <Image> (when asset_url present) and <Text emoji> (fallback).
